The couple is shown sharing a cute and emotional moment which makes the entire painting feel warm and expressive. What makes this artwork truly special is the technique used to create it.

The painting is done using oil colors but instead of the traditional wet oil painting method it is created using the dry brush technique. In this technique the oil colors are applied in a controlled dry form which allows the artist to slowly build textures layers and soft skin tones. The result is a portrait that looks extremely realistic smooth and naturally blended.

This Indonesian inspired dry brush technique is very uncommon in India and very few artists experiment with it because it requires a lot of patience control and experience with oil colors. The most interesting part is that the painting uses only oil colors but they are handled like a dry medium which creates a unique texture and depth in the portrait.
